items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Like Dave here on drums I played with him.

ctx.x: Well now, who were some of the old time musicians that you had played with?

Well like I said, Clayton was one of the, on the trumpet I played with him. Like Dave here on drums I played with him. He's one of the best drummers in the field from the old timers. And well like I said, Hal Kristoff is relative, you know, he came, he's one of the old timers, so to speak. Not as old as Dave, but he's been around that field quite a few times.
I think I'm about the oldest drum player in the city. I don't believe in none of them playing drummers. And I don't care about none of all of that.
